subject: POC success criteria & final readout scheduling — HearthTech POC
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@hearthtech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / success criteria (recap and next steps)

Hi Olivia and Samir —

Thanks again for taking time on the call today. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we have alignment going into the trial: 

- Success criteria: (1) 95% intent classification accuracy on sample dataset provided by HearthTech, (2) average latency < 250ms p95 for 1k QPS target, (3) integration with your redaction pipeline with zero data leakage, and (4) cost per 1k queries below your target of $X (TBD once we get more usage profile).
- Evaluation plan: Redwood provides a 4-week POC environment (dedicated capacity) + test harness. Week 0: data ingest & integration. Weeks 1-3: run evaluation suites & iterate. Week 4: final readout and exec decision.
- Ownership: Marissa (Redwood) — POC coordination and readout scheduling; Marcus (Redwood) — runtime and performance tuning; Neha (Redwood) — security/compliance handoffs; Olivia & Samir (HearthTech) — test data, success criteria sign-off, and internal stakeholders.
- Attachments I shared: redwood-poc-plan.pdf (detailed timeline), SOC2-extract.pdf (security snapshot). Please confirm the success criteria and whether the proposed 4-week timeline works for your side.

Next step: can you confirm a preferred date/time the week of Sep 28 for the final readout? We suggest Thu Sep 30 10:00am PT as a placeholder.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
--
Redwood Inference

From: Olivia Barnes <olivia@hearthtech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@hearthtech.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Sep 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / success criteria (recap and next steps)

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. High level comments from our side:

- Success criteria: the list looks good. We'll add a data-quality metric (missing-schema rate < 2%) and an initial business impact metric: reduction in manual triage time by >= 25% for the sample cohort. I'll push the sample datasets to the S3 link later today.
- Timeline: 4 weeks is fine for the technical evaluation but we need to block exec time the week after Sep 30 for a go/no-go. Can we target Oct 6 for exec readout instead? That gives us a buffer for procurement and legal.
- Procurement: procurement@hearthtech.com needs an updated estimate for reserved capacity and a templated MSA. I'll loop them in.

We confirm Thu Sep 30 is fine for a technical final readout with the engineering stakeholders; Oct 6 would be our preferred exec decision slot.

Thanks,
Olivia
Head of Product | HearthTech
olivia@hearthtech.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@hearthtech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 09:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / success criteria (recap and next steps)

Hi Olivia —

Received the additional criterion (data-quality and business impact) — both sensible. Quick technical notes and ask from our side: 

- Please confirm target load patterns (QPS spikes, typical sequence lengths) so I can pre-tune the Dedicated pool and KV cache parameters.
- For latency target: p95 < 250ms is achievable if we keep batching <= 16 and sequence length under 512 tokens; if your samples run longer we should adjust the latency expectation.
- Integration: we'll need a short week-0 window (2 days) to wire up the redaction pipeline and validate no egress. Neha will run a quick compliance checklist.

Attached: hearthtech-eval-criteria.xlsx (please fill the columns around expected throughput and sample size).

I'll slot time Sep 29 and Sep 30 to support the technical readout — happy to extend to Oct 5 if you need an additional dress rehearsal.

—Marcus
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com

From: procurement@hearthtech.com <procurement@hearthtech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Olivia Barnes <olivia@hearthtech.com>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir@hearthtech.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Sep 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC pricing estimate and MSA request

Hi Marissa / Olivia —

Thanks for the heads up. We need an estimate for the 4-week POC (dedicated capacity) and an MSA template to review. Key constraints: we need standard SLAs for uptime during the POC window and an indemnity clause aligned with our vendor policy. Please also include any anticipated overage costs if we exceed the trial throughput.

Can you provide a one-page pricing summary and a redlined MSA by EOD Fri Sep 4? Our legal team needs lead time before the Oct 6 exec review.

Regards,
HearthTech Procurement
procurement@hearthtech.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Barnes <olivia@hearthtech.com>, procurement@hearthtech.com, Samir Desai <samir@hearthtech.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 08 Sep 2026 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: POC success criteria & final readout scheduling — HearthTech POC

Hi all — quick status update and confirmed schedule: 

- We received the sample data and the filled evaluation sheet from Olivia this morning. Marcus confirmed the Dedicated pool configuration that should meet the stated load (details in the attached plan).
- Procurement: attached is a one-page POC estimate (redwood-poc-plan.pdf) and a pointer to our standard MSA template. I'll send a redlined MSA by Sep 10; in the meantime, we can proceed with the POC kickoff.
- Readout scheduling: Technical readout confirmed for Thu Sep 30 10:00am PT (Marcus + engineering). Executive decision meeting scheduled for Tue Oct 6 9:00am PT (execs from both sides). Please confirm exec attendee list by Sep 24.

Next actions: 
- Marcus to perform the initial performance tuning and smoke tests Sep 14-18.
- Neha to run compliance checklist and provide evidence items by Sep 20.
- Olivia to confirm exec attendees and procurement to confirm MSA priorities.

If there are no objections, we'll treat this as approved and begin week-0 integration next Monday Sep 14.

Thanks —
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan.pdf; hearthtech-eval-criteria.xlsx; SOC2-extract.pdf
